# Sarvada Hospito Care

> Sarvada Hospito Care (A Unit of Servada Hospito Care Pvt. Ltd.) is an ISO 9001:2020 certified premier multi-specialty hospital located in Kankarbagh, Patna, Bihar, India.

## Contact Information
- **Phone:** 7079001600 / 7079001700
- **Email:** sarvadahospitocarepatna@gmail.com
- **Address:** Anand Palace, Bypass Road, Changer, Kankarbagh, Patna, Bihar 800020
- **Hours:** Open 24/7 | Emergency Trauma Care Available

## Main Pages
- [Home Page](https://sarvadahospitocare.com/): Comprehensive homepage displaying hospital overview, emergency contacts, stats, testimonials, and online appointment form.
- [About Us](https://sarvadahospitocare.com/about): Our mission, infrastructure standards, founders, and quality credentials.
- [Our Doctors](https://sarvadahospitocare.com/doctors): Directory of expert medical and surgical specialists including qualifications, fees, and schedules.
- [Book Appointment](https://sarvadahospitocare.com/book-appointment): Direct online booking form.
- [Contact Us](https://sarvadahospitocare.com/contact): Location map, directions, phone list, and inquiry form.

## Clinical Departments
- [Hospital Departments](https://sarvadahospitocare.com/hospital-departments): Specialized units including General Medicine, Pulmonology, Gastroenterology, Cardiology, Nephrology, Pediatrics, Psychiatry, and Dental.
- [Surgical Services](https://sarvadahospitocare.com/surgical-services): Advanced laparoscopic surgeries, general surgeries, plastic/cosmetic surgeries, and neuro/spine procedures.
- [Critical & Emergency Care](https://sarvadahospitocare.com/critical-care): 24/7 ICU, ICCU, HDU, Burn Care, and Emergency Trauma center.

## Patient Facilities & Diagnostics
- [Facilities & Diagnostics](https://sarvadahospitocare.com/facilities-diagnostics): Comprehensive inpatient and outpatient care facilities including:
    - Outpatient Department (OPD) & Inpatient Department (IPD)
    - Day Care Services & Dialysis Unit
    - 24/7 Ambulance & 24/7 Pharmacy
    - Diagnostic Services (Pathology, X-Ray, Ultrasound, Doppler)
    - **Ayushman Bharat Card (PM-JAY)** support for cashless treatment up to ₹5,00,000.
